"""RoboPaint eai-standard/2.2 trajectory for the supplied 'in unum' exemplar.
Run once against the live episode; the service itself records the executed trajectory.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import math, time
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot

# Camera calibrated main-sheet transform. Target pixel centers map to paper millimetres.
MM_PER_PX = 0.00022186
MAIN_FAR_LEFT = np.array([0.01359, 0.11359])  # world (x,y) of target image's far-left corner
PRACTICE_CENTER = np.array([-0.1000, -0.1856])
INK_CENTER = np.array([-0.098, 0.153])
PAPER_Z = 0.020
DOWN = np.array([0., 1., 0., 0.])  # wxyz, pen down and nib edge along world -y


def q_yaw(yaw):
    """Yaw the vertically-down pen; tool y is the writing edge."""
    return np.array([-math.sin(yaw/2), math.cos(yaw/2), 0., 0.], dtype=float)


def pose(x, y, z, q=DOWN):
    return np.r_[np.array([x, y, z], dtype=float), np.asarray(q, dtype=float)]


def paper_xy(u, v):
    # Image top is the far (+x) sheet edge; image left is robot-left (+y).
    X = (float(u) + 0.5) * MM_PER_PX
    Y = (float(v) + 0.5) * MM_PER_PX
    return np.array([MAIN_FAR_LEFT[0] - Y, MAIN_FAR_LEFT[1] - X])


def slerp(q0, q1, t):
    q0=np.asarray(q0,dtype=float); q1=np.asarray(q1,dtype=float)
    q0=q0/np.linalg.norm(q0); q1=q1/np.linalg.norm(q1)
    d=float(np.dot(q0,q1))
    if d<0: q1=-q1; d=-d
    if d>0.9995:
        z=q0+t*(q1-q0); return z/np.linalg.norm(z)
    a=math.acos(max(-1.,min(1.,d))); return (math.sin((1-t)*a)*q0+math.sin(t*a)*q1)/math.sin(a)


def interpolate_poses(start, end, max_xyz=0.0014, max_angle=0.05):
    start=np.asarray(start,dtype=float); end=np.asarray(end,dtype=float)
    dot=abs(float(np.dot(start[3:]/np.linalg.norm(start[3:]),end[3:]/np.linalg.norm(end[3:]))))
    ang=2*math.acos(max(-1.,min(1.,dot)))
    n=max(1,int(math.ceil(np.linalg.norm(end[:3]-start[:3])/max_xyz)),int(math.ceil(ang/max_angle)))
    return np.stack([np.r_[start[:3]+(end[:3]-start[:3])*(i/n),slerp(start[3:],end[3:],i/n)] for i in range(1,n+1)])


def send_poses(r, targets, note="", cameras=None, video="none"):
    targets=np.asarray(targets,dtype=np.float32).reshape(-1,7)
    out=[]
    for i in range(0,len(targets),400):
        res=r.submit("ee_pose",targets[i:i+400],dt=0.05,video=video,cameras=cameras,note=note)
        out.append(res)
        print(note, "rows",i,"+",res.meta.get("executed_rows"),"plan",res.meta.get("plan"),flush=True)
        if res.done: break
    return out


def move_to(r, target, **kwargs):
    now=np.asarray(r.get_obs(video="none").meta["proprio"]["now"],dtype=float)
    pnow=now[7:14]
    return send_poses(r,interpolate_poses(pnow,target),**kwargs)


def main():
    r=Robot(); print("status",r.status(),flush=True)
    obs=r.get_obs(video="none")
    print("tip",obs.meta['proprio']['now'][7:14],flush=True)
    # Retract before crossing the table, dip to the center of the ink well, and lift.
    move_to(r,pose(0.,0.,0.180),note="clear main sheet")
    move_to(r,pose(INK_CENTER[0],INK_CENTER[1],0.100),note="above ink well")
    move_to(r,pose(INK_CENTER[0],INK_CENTER[1],0.022),note="dip pen")
    move_to(r,pose(INK_CENTER[0],INK_CENTER[1],0.100),note="lift from ink")
    # Approach the center of the practice sheet above the paper.
    move_to(r,pose(PRACTICE_CENTER[0],PRACTICE_CENTER[1],0.100),note="above practice sheet")
    # A short straight contact checks ink loading, contact depth and mark width.
    start=pose(PRACTICE_CENTER[0]-0.025,PRACTICE_CENTER[1],0.015)
    end=pose(PRACTICE_CENTER[0]+0.025,PRACTICE_CENTER[1],0.015)
    move_to(r,pose(start[0],start[1],0.100),note="practice approach")
    move_to(r,start,note="practice touch")
    line=interpolate_poses(start,end,max_xyz=0.0010)
    send_poses(r,line,note="practice calibration line",cameras=["practice_cam","side_cam"],video="mp4")
    move_to(r,pose(end[0],end[1],0.100),note="practice lift")
    obs=r.get_obs(cameras=["practice_cam","scene_cam","side_cam"],video="none")
    from PIL import Image
    for cam,img in obs.last.items(): Image.fromarray(img).save(f"/app/output/practice_{cam}.png")
    print("status",r.status(),flush=True)
    print("tip",obs.meta['proprio']['now'][7:14],flush=True)

if __name__ == "__main__": main()
